content: Wheelchairs are specifically designed for children under the age of 12 who have physical impairments. These mobility devices are tailored to meet the unique anatomical and functional needs of young patients, ensuring proper support, comfort, and ease of movement. Pediatric wheelchairs often incorporate adjustable features to accommodate growth and development, as well as specialized seating systems to promote optimal posture and prevent secondary complications such as pressure sores or musculoskeletal deformities. Additionally, these wheelchairs may include lightweight frames and customizable components to enhance maneuverability and independence for the child.
